تفتروا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرُوا (taftarū) /taf.ta.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَى (iftarā)
# تُفْتَرَوْا (tuftaraw) /tuf.ta.raw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَى (iftarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
